title: Hysteresis-based circuit and tenant-weighted shedding hotfix for regional SLO stability
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Fix: Stabilize SLO enforcement during regional slowdowns by adding hysteresis to circuit state transitions and tenant-weighted shedding; reduces oscillation and prevents cascade failovers.
merge_commit_summary: squash: hysteresis circuit + tenant-weighted shedder hotfix
discussion_summary: Reviewer feedback focused on guardrails for hysteresis windows and ensuring tenant weights cannot be gamed; added extra telemetry and a conservative default rollout.
notes_for_oncall: Watch circuit_hysteresis_state flips and tenant_shed_decision metrics; conservative defaults (cooldown=45s, closeThreshold=3); revert via feature toggle if needed.
